_comment: ARENA exercise GROUPS: the third level under a section (0.1 -> 0.1.2). A group is a run of ARENA's own exercises whose code builds on each other, worked in order as one small codebase. Parts are keyed like lessons/arena_exercise_kcs.json (slug, then the function the exercise defines). `fn` and the group fields are authored; `cell`, `kc` and `title` on each part are filled and checked by scripts/check_arena_groups.py --write. Only exercises with a stub and a concept belong here: given code (Sequential, copy_weights, the hook helpers) is not a part, and 0.1's video & lighting exercises have no concept yet.
